_about.what_this_is: A hand-verified reference chain of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES' nominal share capital, used ONLY as a test oracle. Every row was re-read directly in the OCR of the cited document during verification, and the bbox below was computed by the same conversion the pipeline uses.
what_this_is_NOT: This is NOT an answer key. The challenge states plainly that no answer key exists and that Takeovers' own cross-checks flag unadjudicated contradictions in this company's capital chain.
This is NOT results.json and does not follow results.schema.json. results.json is the deliverable; this file is a regression oracle with a different shape and a different purpose.
This is NOT a shareholder ledger. Holder information appears only where a document states it. Where it does not, the field is null and `holders_status` says so.
_about.how_to_use: The pipeline must reproduce `capital_eur_after`, `shares_total_after` and `nominal_eur` for every row whose `status` is VERIFIED. Rows marked UNCERTAIN must not be used to fail a build; they are recorded so the uncertainty survives into the README instead of being quietly resolved.
_about.provenance_convention: bbox = [x0, y0, x1, y1], normalized 0-1 against that page's own width/height in points, origin top-left, page 1-indexed. OCR polygons are pixels at 300 dpi; conversion is px / (page.rect.<dim> * 300/72).

legend.VERIFIED: every numeric field in the row is stated explicitly in the cited document and was read directly.
legend.UNCERTAIN: the numbers are stated, but some attribute (typically the effective date) is not unambiguously fixed by the corpus.
legend.UNSUPPORTED: no document in this corpus states it. Recorded as null, never inferred into a number.

chain.document_internal_error: The Article 6 clause added by this same decision reads "le capital social a été augmenté de 185 759 euros ... pour être porté à 400 000" on p.3, repeated verbatim on p.7 of the updated statutes. The operative decision on p.2 says 182 759, twice, and 217 241 + 182 759 = 400 000 exactly. Verified by rendering p.3 at 130 dpi and reading it directly: the PDF really does print 185 759, so this is the drafter's error propagated into the statutes, NOT an OCR artefact. 182 759 is used.
